summary: Character Info values centred in their kit boxes
author: pm
body:
The Character Info dialog drew its values at the old sprite's text positions (put_aligned_string with hand-placed x ranges and y), not in the kit's value boxes, so several sat high or off-centre (Next EXP, EK.Count, Str/Dex/Int/Mag).

Fix: the row table (label, box) is shared, and each value is drawn with draw_text_aligned, Align::Center, over its box rect.

**Done when:** every value is centred both ways in its box, checked in the client.

Source: user request 2026-11-25; DialogBox_Character::on_draw in dialog_box_character.cpp.

**Verified, 2026-11-25:** built (Game Debug), Character Info in the client: every value centred in its box; review PASS.
